book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso fɛ muh goŋ yì baaŋ
Sege Jiso gɛ̀ ja yi mbegɛ le wu boh, kinchvu ki bamii kì baaŋ banyɛ ki bii wu le.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ muh wumu wù gɛ̀ chɛne bɛ goŋ yì baaŋ, gɛ̀ ja wu to wu tuŋ anyuu a Jiso fwe wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Tada, taŋlo wo fɛ mɛ n'yuude, fɛ wo nɛ koŋe lo.”
Jiso mo wu nɛjɛ kibo wu kuŋ wu le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
Kimimia, goŋ yì baaŋ yiyu mo yi ka ye ye le, wu mo wu tu wu yuude.
Jiso chiisɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo yɛ̂ne, keefɛ wo sɛ̂ɛŋ muh le gɛ. Geenɛ, gɛnɛ wo chûnyɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ chiji kintanyɛ le, wo mo wo nya nnyaa yì Musɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ muh kɛmɛ ki wu nyâ ki wu chûnyɛ bamii le lɛ wu le wu tɛmɛ wa yi goŋ yinɛ le wu tu wu yûude.”

content: Jiso fɛ mwa lɛme wu kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu gɛɛŋ wu lee a kilaantɛŋ kì Kafanahum le, kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi kimi gɛ̀ to ki yɛŋ wu le ki ku chiaaŋ wu le ki du lɛ,
“Tada, mwa yaŋ wu lɛme gime yeh wu ŋgɛɛse lo, wu le wu kwe wa kimbe kimimia.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
Geenɛ, kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi kɛɛ chvuu Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, gɛ ŋkooji muh wù taŋlo wo to a wu yeh gɛ. Jɛmɛ gɛh nyu jɛ mwa yaŋ wu lɛme mo wu tɛmɛ.
Nle a bvuŋga bvu muh mu kuu, bamii ba nchi nyu tɛ a mɛ kuu. Njɛme muh le lɛ, ‘Gɛ̂nɛ’, wu mo wu gɛɛne lo, ndu muh le lɛ, ‘Tô’, wu mo wu too lo. Ndu tɛ nfwa waŋ le lɛ, ‘Gêe nɛ’, wu mo wu gee lo.”
Jiso doo wu yu fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme, jwe yuŋ lo wu. Wu jɛmɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ bii wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, ŋge mbaaŋ a n'yɛŋ gɛ muh le Ishwala wù lese kfuu chi finɛ fitele yi ye yaŋ le nɛ gɛ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ bamii wesee le bo ja bimbe le bichii, kɛge a juu saane yo gɛɛne bude a chi seele yo, bo to bo shii bo jii mwɛɛ bɛ bachiji bena wù Ablaham mo Asik mo Yakob woŋ wu Nyo wu fɛwe le,
geenɛ, booŋ ba woŋ wuyu le wuboo le ba noŋ bo yi kijibɛ le akfuuŋ fɛ bamii lé bo gê bo beede bo ŋgeji bige.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo wu mo wu du kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi kɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo gɛɛne la, fi lé fi gê noo no wo le wo leesɛ fitele ye yaŋ le.”

content: Mwa lɛme wu kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba nchi wuyu mo wu tɛmɛ lo gɛh ki sege.
Jiso fɛ bamii ba binchɛŋ wesee
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu gɛɛŋ wu lee a Bita yeh, wu yɛŋ mwɛɛdɛ Bita gime wu chɛne bɛ kin'ya.
Jiso kuŋ kibo ke le, kin'ya kiyu mo ki chinɛ wu le, wu mo wu ja we wu bijɛ fiɛɛ Jiso ji.
Lɛ nyu fɛnfu, bamii tu bo too bɛ bamii wesee ba banchɛndaa ba debele gɛ̀ njiiŋse bɛ bo. Jiso tu wu bvuuse biyo biyu nyu gɛh bɛ jɛ maa. Wu ka fɛde tɛ bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ chɛne.
Finɛ fiɛɛ gɛ̀ kooshi ki fi gê fi kojɛ no muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Yosaya gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa lɛ, “Wu le wu jo wa goŋ yese besabɛŋ, wu tuu binchɛŋ biɛsa.”
Baŋgɛ ba muh wù bii Jiso le
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu yɛŋ kinchvu ki bamii kì baaŋ taashɛ mbebe ye le, wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bee daŋ mamasi bee gɛɛŋ wuŋ kwege.”

content: Muh wumu wù gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo mo wu kɛŋsɛ wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh n'yɛyɛ, nlé mbîi wo le mo nyu faaŋ fɛ wo gɛɛne fo.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Binchombiaŋ kɛme bintuge biboo, munyii mù fuune we kɛme yéh yiboo, geenɛ gɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme lo fɛ wu giŋsɛ kikwɛɛ ke fo gɛ.”

content: Muh we wu ŋgoo wumu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Tada, chinɛ ŋgɛɛŋ njiiyɛ chijaŋ fɛ nto mbii.”
Geenɛ Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo bîi mɛne, chinɛ bamii ba kweeyɛ wa bo jiiyi bamii baboo ba kweeyɛ wa.”

content: Jiso waŋ nfuŋ
Jiso gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ wu lee a ŋguh le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo bi tɛ wu le yo.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ nfuŋ wumu wù baaŋ ja gɛh wu jaŋɛ wu kɛ a mamasi wuyu le wu shiŋshi joo yi bɛɛne yi lese a ŋguh le, yi goone ki yi yîsɛ a ŋguh le. Gɛ̀ bee Jiso lefe lo fie.
Booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛɛŋ bo kaŋsɛ wu bo du lɛ, “Tada, fi bee, bee lé be kwêeyɛ.”
Wu kaŋsɛ wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ooo bamii ba mbɛmɛ wù shige. Bɛŋ faane la?”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo wu mo wu ja we wu waŋ nfuŋ wuyu mo joo yì baaŋ, mu lu, manjuu chii nɛ nshiiŋŋ.
Jwe yuŋ bamii bayu nɛ kah. Bo ghaade lɛ, “Kfuu chi wunɛ muh le wu nɛɛ wù nfuŋ bɛ joo yuge wu le?”
Jiso bvusɛ banchɛndaa ba debele yi bamii le bafɛɛ
Jiso gɛ̀ daŋ wu bu wuŋ kwege kimbe ki bamii ba Gadala le.
Bɛ bamii bafɛɛ tasɛ banchɛndaa ba debele nyu yi bo le. Bamii bayu gɛ̀ bu afuuŋ yì ba gɛ̀ jiiyi bamii yo le, bo gɛ̀ ŋase baaŋ taŋlo muh gɛ fe lo je yo gɛ.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ bo gɛ̀ kɛ bo tu bo wane fɛwɛɛwe bo biide lɛ, “Mwa Nyo, wo fii la a bee le? Wo to fɛnɛ ki wo nyâ ŋgɛ bee le kife baaŋ a kojɛ gɛ?”
Gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi munyuŋa jii kimbe kiyu le mu duude lo.
Banchɛndaa ba debele bayu mo bo lɛgɛ Jiso lɛ, “Kii wo, wo nɛ le wo bvusɛ bee, wo chiiŋsɛ bee yi munyuŋa mwege le.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,
Bo mo bo bu, bo gɛɛŋ bo lee yi munyuŋa muyu le. Fi kooshɛ lɛ ŋgoo yi munyuŋa yiyu yichii gɛ̀ kɛŋ yi boh a kiŋkoŋ le, mu shii a mamasi le mu kweeyɛ yo.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne munyuŋa muyu fɛɛ lo, bo gɛɛŋ a kilaantɛŋ le, bo sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii nchensɛŋ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ bɛ bamii ba banchɛndaa ba debele gɛ̀ bee yi bo le.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ kilaantɛŋ kiyu kichii gɛ̀ bu lo ki to ki yɛŋ Jiso le. No bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ wu le, bo lɛgɛ lɛ wu ja gwɛŋ wuboo le.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu tɛŋe lɛ, “Gadalɛŋ, bamu lɛ Gɛlgɛseŋ.”
